name: 漫画单页
description: 单页或跨页漫画分镜，不规则格子+对话+心声
prompt_template: Manga single page spread, title: {title}. Scene: {scene}. {panel_count} panels with irregular layouts. Mood: {mood}. Japanese manga art style, expressive characters, dynamic composition. Speed lines and effect marks for action scenes. Inner thoughts shown in smaller panels.
